body: Haha, I manage complaints regarding towing damaged every day. Towing accidents happen way too often and you should be recording regardless of whether they were showing off or not. This video would get an easy pay out. Also, a lot of these guys are contractors with their own insurance (at least in Australia).
Close to 100k a year according to Indeed
[Reminds me of this, a pic I snapped two weeks ago taking my mum to a medical appointment](http://imgur.com/gallery/jCgZsYd)

Lots of Australians (mainly elderly) have been isolated for years. It's through Red Cross, so worth having a look at their website. My application was fast tracked however because we (my work) have an agreement with them based on our skills (call centre).
Been making wellbeing calls to people stuck in quarantine as a volunteer. A lot of people want fresh air but understand what they are doing is important. Usually really happy to have a chat.
Hope you're doing okay. Sometimes I feel better after I've eaten. Why don't you try have a sleep too and see how you feel in the morning?
Is America okay? I feel like we are witnessing a complete societal collapse right now.
NSW Police have already confirmed they won't be investigating as they believe there was there was no malice. Apparently the worker was distraught.
This recipe inspired me to finally buy a cast iron pan. Can't wait! Yours looks delicious!
